description: Great having my friends, Mary Anne Seraphin and Dana Riegert, on my podcast! We talked about the many Friends of the J.V. Fletcher Library activities and what to expect when the library moves to its temporary location during renovations! Take a listen!

title: Friends of the J.V. Fletcher Library — State Rep. James Arciero
